title: Fix for /proc/%s/compatible permission denied crash in Proot-distro in Termux on Android.
description: This fix handles crash when /proc/%s/compatible is permission denied since previous code only catched exception on file not found. This will allow upgrades of Ubuntu running in proot distro in Termux on Android.
commit_message: Fix for /proc/%s/compatible permission denied crash in Proot-distro in Termux on Android.
